name: skills
title_zh: 官方 44 个技能合集，一次装齐 OpenAI 精选
tagline_zh: 不用再一个个翻 GitHub 找 skill。44 个官方验证过的技能，覆盖写代码、做表格、处理文档，装完就能用。
tagline_en: Stop hunting for skills one by one. 44 official, battle-tested workflows for code, spreadsheets, and docs—install.
why_zh: 这是 OpenAI 官方仓库，每个技能都经过内部验证，质量有保底。合集安装，一次搞定依赖和版本匹配。
why_en: Straight from OpenAI's official repo—every skill is internally vetted. One-shot install handles dependencies and version.
limit_zh: 只含 OpenAI 官方收录的 44 个，社区技能不在此列。部分技能需额外 API key 或本地环境（如浏览器。
limit_en: Only the 44 official skills—no community ones. Some require extra API keys or local tools (browser, DB). Install ≠ ready: each skill needs its own.
